description: List Asana tasks by project or assignee, optionally filtered by completion.

assignee_gid.description: Optional unique identifier (gid) of the user whose assigned tasks to list, used when no project_gid is given.

completed.description: Optional completion filter applied client-side: true returns only completed tasks, false only incomplete tasks.

project_gid.description: Optional unique identifier (gid) of the project whose tasks to list; takes precedence over assignee_gid when both are given.

name: list_tasks
